sources.excerpt: Judge Dredd Lawbringer Gunshot by ThorpyFX | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE ThorpyFX Judge Dredd Lawbringer Gunshot LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS OVERDRIVE Description “I AM THE LAW.” The Lawbringer overdrive embodies Judge Dredd’s unrelenting sense of justice, placing tone and authority above all else. Based on the award-winning Gunshot circuit, it blends stacked gain stages for the ultimate British-style overdrive. From gritty blues to full-bore hard rock, its cascading gain engine delivers warmth, punch, and addictive harmonic bite. Every note responds like a great valve amp, rich and commanding without losing clarity or feel. Built like a tank with recessed knobs, top-mounted jacks, and a laser-etched stainless steel console. Inside, precision components ensure durability, power, and tone worthy of Mega-City One’s finest. And You Shall Receive Skip to main content Boutique & Vintage Guitar Effects, Guitars & Amplifiers 🇨🇦 CAD 🇺🇸 USD 0 items Menu Search Search Main navigation Catalog Home Brands What's Hot Search Search Store info News About Contact ThorpyFX Judge Dredd Lawbringer (Gunshot) Brand: ThorpyFX $309.00 Body "I AM THE LAW"   ThorpyFx X 2000AD Collaboration The Lawbringer overdrive aims to place Law above all else in line with Judge Dredds singular uncompromising attitude. with stacked gain stages you can blend the calibre and gain together to tailor and deliver the perfect British style overdrive. The Lawbringer is based upon The award winning Gunshot overdrive. Designed to deliver awesome rock tones you love, with refreshed artwork. The Lawbringer/GUNSHOT was designed to be the overdrive to beat all others. Sonically most overdrives can sound thin or lack a certain “something” when compared to a real valve amplifier. It’s an unfair comparison really, but it is possible to solve this problem. This is where the Lawbringer/GUNSHOT comes in, at the heart of the pedal is a proprietary cascading "gain engine" tuned to deliver maximum tonality for as wide a range of amps as possible. Through tweaking the pedals controls to taste you can achieve overdrive flavours from subtle through to searing, think slightly hairy blues to hard rock. The tones produced are addictive and inspiring in equal measure. Aside from achieving fantastic sonic credentials the Lawbringer/GUNSHOT is built like a tank with physical features such as recessed knobs and top mounted jacks. Robust build does not have to come at the sacrifice of looks, the Lawbringer/GUNSHOT uses a combination of a beautiful stainless steel laser etched centre console wrapped in a tough baseplate. Internally the premium sound is enhanced through the use of premium components all wrapped in a beautiful custom engineered enclosure.
